race.description: Chaff City - Choice Of Champions Mdn
race.comment: The flying CARTIER GLOW (8) has led for home at all three runs to date but is being cut down late, the latest over this course and distance when beaten a whisker. Blinkers going on might be the key to finding that little extra edge. MY MALENA (11) hasn't been all that far away in three runs to date, the pick of those efforts a second on debut over 1000m at this track. Perfectly drawn and should give a good account again. PROFOUND BENEFIT (1) is now 21 runs without a win. Freshened up and has placed at three of six here. Each-way. INTIMIDATION TIME (5) gets a host of gear changes for this first-up run. Respect any positive market action. First starter BOLD FLYING (9) won a recent Lark Hill trial and looks ready to make a bright start to his career.
